## Before submitting

- [ ] I agree to license this contribution under the terms of [LICENSE.txt](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/LICENSE.txt).
- [x] I ran `pre-commit run` and committed any formatting changes.
- [x] I reviewed the Hard Rules in the applicable `AGENTS.md` files.
- [x] I added GitHub labels: one `cat-*`, one or more `area:*` / `op:*`, and one `orig-*`.

## Affected area

CI or test infrastructure.

## Summary

Add `[block_table_ptr]` to the stale SDPA binding test ID in the three smoke lists and their matching code-path rows. This keeps the original missing-block-table check and each list's cell count. The other parameter remains in L0/FULL coverage.

## Why

#2175 parametrized `test_sm107_dense_only_host_cannot_bind_paged_plan`, so its earlier unqualified ID no longer collects. Nightly pipeline 78572446, job 523810664, fails the three `test_every_listed_cell_collects` cases at source `8bf98c99cfbd9f6fe8515caf539d8ab53384a954`. The stale rows remain on develop `97b7bc3128d6f7148133a61de7845eb3a9bbbef2`.

## Related issues

Follow-up to #2175. Auto-FE todo 0010.

## API and compatibility impact

None. Six test-data rows only; all checks remain intact.

## Testing

Rebuilt native bindings from this worktree and verified package/native import paths on SM100. From `test/python`:

```
python -m pytest -o addopts= -n 0 -rA --tb=short   'test_tiers.py::test_every_listed_cell_collects[smoke_cc100.txt]'   'test_tiers.py::test_every_listed_cell_collects[smoke_cc103.txt]'   'test_tiers.py::test_every_listed_cell_collects[smoke_cc107.txt]'   test_tiers.py::test_smoke_code_paths_cover_exactly_the_listed_cells   sdpa/frost/test_sdpa_native_arch_binding.py::test_sm107_dense_only_host_cannot_bind_paged_plan
```

- Before: the three collection checks fail on the stale ID.
- After: 7 passed, 1 failed. Both binding variants and all code-path/list equality checks pass. The remaining cc107 collection failure names four unrelated FP4 cases whose modules skip under local Torch 2.7; it no longer names this SDPA test.
- A focused collection check for this module changes from a missing listed ID to no missing IDs in all three lists.
- `-m smoke --collect-only` selects exactly the module's listed cells for each tier override.
- Changed-file pre-commit exits 0 (no applicable hooks for these data files); `git diff --check` passes.

Draft pending targeted `python/misc` CI, which runs the full tier checks with the CI environment. No full cc107 tier pass is claimed locally.
